tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows saturation but leaves the bridge mechanism and dependence on other inputs unidentified. A discriminating open-branch probe is warranted before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now, so they cannot establish whether the saturating response depends on the other inputs or a mobility bridge.
The observed response is strongly sublinear in u_now, inconsistent with a simple bilinear law at fixed x_now.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly addresses the unresolved mechanism.
